caption:
On sincerity of intention: actions are judged by what you intended.

Sahih al-Bukhari, Book 1, Hadith 1. Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean and Japanese renderings.

Sources on the final slide.

sourcing.primary_text: Sahih al-Bukhari, Book 1 (Revelation), Hadith 1, narrated by 'Umar ibn al-Khattab
sourcing.arabic: Matn only (isnad omitted for slide length), edition ara-bukhari, cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/fawazahmed0/hadith-api
sourcing.english: Muhsin Khan translation, edition eng-bukhari, cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/fawazahmed0/hadith-api. Quoted verbatim including its own 'So whoever' phrasing, since editing a named translator's quoted words would itself be a misattribution risk.
sourcing.chinese_korean_japanese: No Chinese, Korean, or Japanese edition exists in the fawazahmed0/hadith-api catalogue (confirmed by reading its full editions.json: only Arabic, Bengali, English, French, Indonesian, Russian, Tamil, Turkish and Urdu are covered, across all ten collections). A web search for an alternative reputable source turned up nothing citable either. These three renderings are therefore my own careful translation from the verified Arabic and English above, not a named external source, and are labelled as translations on-slide and in the caption rather than attributed to a scholar who did not produce them.
sourcing.verification_note: Arabic and English are primary-sourced and citable; Chinese, Korean and Japanese are transparently labelled translations. See channels.json's ig-blankdiscussions._niche_note for why honest sourcing is a hard requirement for this channel.
